promptAppend: This is a self-hosted single-operator radio station, not a multi-tenant SaaS. There are no user accounts, no cookies and no browser-credentialed sessions — only one admin (HTTP Basic via requireAdmin) and anonymous public listeners. Do not report CSRF, session fixation, or missing per-user authorization; there is no such model. Weigh findings by whether they let an unauthenticated listener reach admin-only settings/secrets, inject into the LLM prompt chain or the on-air voice, escape the state/ directory, or forge Liquidsoap/Icecast control input.
